headline: AfD 🏛️ Claims DEMOCRACY 💬 Demands COALITION 🍆 After SAXONY 🗳️ Landslide
text:
GERMANY'S 🐺 far-right AfD just COOKED 🔥 the eastern state of Saxony-Anhalt with a MASSIVE 🍑 43.8 PERCENT 📈 vote share leaving them THREE 🪑 seats shy of outright MAJORITY 👑 and now they're edging 😩 every other party to hop on their governing DICKtatorship because Ulrich Siegmund the local daddy 🧔‍♂️ says it's a "clear mandate to govern" after they RAILED 💦 the polls on Sunday night 🌙!! Beatrix von Storch is out here STROKING 🖐️ the opposition telling them "You cannot say I do not accept the vote of the people" while the whole CDU got their cheeks CLAPPED 🙇‍♂️ down to a pathetic 17.2 percent and now Chancellor Friedrich Merz is DEEPLY 🕳️ SHOCKED 😵 like he just got pegged by history itself!! No far-right party has gripped a German state since WW2 so this is straight up SEISMIC 🌋 for policing 🛡️ and local education 📚 with AfD plotting special classes for child refugees and a whole task-force to round up and DEPORT 🚫 those migrants who overstayed their welcome which has everyone from Berlin to Brussels sweating bullets 💧!!

Von Storch keeps hammering that the results "were on the table and now democrats have to talk to one another" because this is what DEMOCRACY 🍆 demands or else they risk total CHAOS 🌀 and maybe a brand new election that could let AfD daddy Siegmund finally slide into power without compromising his hard remigration 🍑 goals that everyone calls mass deportation in disguise!! The state's defeated CDU premier Sven Schulze basically folded 🙇 and admitted the mandate now lies with the AfD while domestic intelligence still labels the local crew right-wing extremist which Siegmund at 35 hotly rejects like a true wolf in sheep's clothing 🐺!! With only 2.1 million people in Saxony-Anhalt this win is sending SHOCKWAVES 🌊 across Germany especially since AfD is already polling top nationally and just barely missed grabbing full control in neighboring Thuringia last year!!

They're currently locked at 39 seats in the 83-seat parliament so talks kicked off Sunday night with everyone from unhappy CDU rebels to the tiny left-wing populist BSW that wants Russian gas imports and is also super tough on immigration 🛂 which could lead to a sneaky tacit support deal letting AfD run a minority government without full penetration 🤝!! Siegmund told the press they're reaching out to every parliamentary group and individual MP willing to help them form this unholy alliance while floating the idea of another election if nobody bends the knee fast enough!! Merz is calling this the worst CDU spanking in decades and says no more business as usual they need profound reforms to reach voters on an emotional level before the next regional votes in Mecklenburg and Berlin turn into even bigger disasters for the conservatives!!

Commentators are screaming this is a full watershed moment a break with the past and Siegmund hyped it to supporters as "a self-confident signal for the whole of Germany" while Donald Trump blasted the results all over Truth Social like the ultimate hype man 🇺🇸 and some Russian envoy Kirill Dmitriev jumped in praising the "historic win for the pragmatic AfD" calling them the party of hope reason and co-operation with Russian gas obviously!! JD Vance threw his weight behind them last year which Germans called straight up interference and Polish PM Donald Tusk clapped back hard saying only idiots and traitors rejoice at AfD's triumph!! Von Storch told the BBC the scared folks are just afraid of losing their economy and inner security which is why conservative voters are fleeing to alternatives that actually listen!!

She warned everyone to wake up and see what's happening across Europe where conservative parties are vanishing from the landscape like in Italy the UK and soon France if they don't get their act together and start talking to the far-right instead of clutching pearls 🦪!! The AfD's plans for segregating refugee kids and building deportation squads have the whole country in meltdown but Siegmund insists it's all about democracy demanding they get a seat at the big boy table after this landslide that fell just short of the 42 seats needed for total control!! Whether they cook up a minority government with BSW help or force fresh elections the signal is clear this eastern heartland win is only the beginning for AfD's national dominance and everyone's political hole is about to get stretched!!
